title: mortal kombat x
text: EDIT: XL update As I stopped following MKX since support was dropped I was extremely suprised and happy to see MKX XL update appear in downloads. As said in my original review it is a great game and I loved it but without the netcode update and content updates it didn't feel worth sinking time into. I may get back into it at some point but I highly recommend it now that it is on parity with consoles. Original: I never got into any Mortal Kombat games before and I decided this would be the one. Of the 5 or so hours I played I thoroughly enjoyed it and was looking forward to putting many hours into it. I was especially excited to hear about KP2 and the GGPO netcode fix coming only to discover today directly from NRS' mouth that they are dropping support for PC. If this decision was based on WB's perceived notion that they wouldn't make a profit off the PC player base currently the irony is that fixing the netcode I'm sure would have brought back many players who in turn may have bought KP2 and any future DLC. I'm glad I only paid $15 for the game and that they didn't get any of that money. I will not buy any of WB or NRS games again. Vote with your wallet if you don't want this to happen again to the PC community. The more I play MKX the more I love it but I wonder if continually playing it and building my skills is worth it in a game that for a lack of a better metaphor, has effectively had it's throat cut and is slowly bleeding to death.

title: multiwinia
text: Multiwinia is a RTS game, but it is NOT the kind of RTS you would think it would be. Multiwinia is probably (if not), IS the most unique RTS games I have ever played in my life. What makes Multiwinia a one-of-a-kind game? Well let me tell you: 1. Unlike most RTS games, Multiwinia features one main unit: The Darwinian. 2. Despite there being only one unit, there are CRATES that can give many different power-ups that can turn the tide of the battlefield. Whether you get reinforcements, turrets, viruses, NUKES!, and even Dragons! 3. Multiwinia also features different game modes, like Capture the Flag/Point(s), Domination, Assault, and a few more. 4. All Multiwinians are the same, nothing counters another. In Multiwinia, the only thing you need, is a STRATEGY. Ok, I said some things that make the game unique. Now I'm going to tell you some other things you need to know if you plan on gettings Multiwinia: 1. Multiwinia is the MULTIPLAYER version of Darwinia. There is no campaign for Multiwinia because Darwinia has the campaign, if you want story mode, get Darwinia. 2. Multiwinia is FUN. Whether you get addicted or not, is beyond me. But one thing is for sure, if your bored, play this game! 3. Multiwinia is cheap. The game is really old, so I mean that's probably why it's cheap. BUT, your paying for plenty of fun content! Would I recommend this game? OF COURSE! Multiwinia is 10 bucks, but on sale, it gets as cheap as 2 dollars! But I recommend you get Darwinia + Multiwinia, so you have the campaign AND multiplayer. It's probably 4 or 5 bucks on sale. TL;DR Multiwinia is a multiplayer version of Darwinia, which has the campaign. Multiwinia is a very fun and unique RTS game. If you want a RTS with simple mechanics and fun gameplay, get this game!
